project_info.theme: Direct-flash red-carpet portrait in a fitted black crushed-velvet dress

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with fair skin, blue eyes and a shoulder-length blonde bob styled in textured beachy waves with a slightly wet-look finish. She wears smokey eye makeup, matte nude-pink lipstick and a black choker with a small dark pendant. Her fitted black crushed-velvet midi dress has a square scoop neckline, wide tank straps and a structured bodice. She stands confidently with relaxed arms and a neutral direct gaze.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic red-carpet portrait of a clearly adult woman with fair skin, blue eyes and a shoulder-length blonde bob styled in textured beachy waves with a slightly wet-look finish. Use smokey eye makeup, heavy black eyeliner, defined eyebrows and matte nude-pink lipstick. She wears a fitted black midi dress made of crushed velvet with a square scoop neckline, wide tank-style straps and a structured bodice, plus a thin black choker with a small dark pendant. Pose her confidently with arms relaxed at her sides or lightly behind her back and a neutral direct gaze. Set her before a solid red event wall with large partial metallic silver fictional letters. Use bright direct flash that highlights velvet texture and blonde hair, creating soft shadows against the red background. Medium-to-three-quarter portrait framing, sharp focus and high-resolution red-carpet photography. Preserve the source dress, hair, pose and flash mood while keeping the clearly adult fashion framing non-explicit.
